text:
Priya: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's DR test — running list of action items and owners. Root cause summary: flapping BGP announcements causing transient multi-region route divergence + delayed snapshot replay during restore. I'll capture owners and ETAs here.

Alex: I'll take the routing work. Plan: add health-check gating before we advertise regional routes and update route-preference docs. Will open a design PR tomorrow. ETA: end of week.

Maya: I'll own backups and restore validation. Next steps: validate cross-region snapshot integrity, add checksum verification, and create an automated nightly restore test in CI. ETA: next Wed (will post checklist).

Jordan: Runbooks + game day coordination are on me. I'll consolidate the restore runbook (trim manual steps, add clear rollback points), and schedule a game day with SRE + Platform for next Monday. Need volunteers for observer/runner roles.

Lee: Quick note on routing details — we should prefer-local for intra-region pref and add a short AS-path filter to avoid learning stale pref. I'll open the small config PR and a test plan.

Priya: Action summary I'm recording in the postmortem doc: 1) Routing gating & config PR (Alex/Lee) — owner: Alex, co-owner: Lee — ETA: Fri end-of-day. 2) Backup integrity + nightly restore CI job (Maya) — ETA: Wed. 3) Runbook consolidation + game day (Jordan) — ETA: next Monday; game-day invite out by EOD. 4) Ops alerting: add a dedicated routing-flap pager for early detection (SRE team) — ETA: next sprint.

Alex: Quick troubleshooting snippets I'm saving into the runbook:
```
# verify route propagation to eu-west-1 peers
bgpctl show routes | grep eu-west-1
# basic region health check
curl -sS https://health.internal/region | jq '.status'
```

Maya: CI job I'll add: `.github/workflows/nightly-restore.yml` — it will: create a temp cluster, restore latest cross-region snapshot, run smoke tests, report back to #incidents. If any step fails, auto-create a ticket in the postmortem board.

Jordan: For the game day, proposed agenda: 1) kickoff + goals, 2) simulated failover (warm-standby), 3) timed restore drill, 4) retrospective + action capture. Volunteers: @Alex, @Maya, @Lee please confirm.

Lee: Confirmed for routing tests and can be runner for the simulated failover. :thumbsup:

Alex: Confirmed — will review PR template for routing gating and add a canary plan.

Maya: Confirmed — will own restore test runner and posting results to the doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: Game day created — <https://redwood.company/events/dr-game-day-2026|DR Game Day — Mon> (organiser: Jordan).

Priya: I've updated the postmortem doc with these owners and set the priority to P1 for routing and backups. I'll run a check-in on Friday 10:00am PT to verify PRs/CI progress. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly.

Jordan: I'll add the runbook PR and the game day invite, and create the postmortem action checklist with owners + explicit rollback steps.

Lee: FYI I'll add two unit tests for the routing reconverge deterministic behaviour into `routing-tests/`.

Alex: Minor follow-up — add an alert threshold for >3 BGP updates/min from a single region to trigger pre-failover throttling. I'll include in PR.

Priya: Great — thanks team. I'll consolidate everything into the follow-up tracker and mark owners. Next check-in: Fri 10am PT.

Lee: :thumbsup:

Maya: ack

Jordan: cool.
